title: MEG screen state diagram
description: Which screen the game is on. The page runs one animation loop; the state decides whether the world is simulated, shown behind a menu, or frozen.

states.description: Title screen over an attract-mode ocean with a shark swimming a fixed path; file buttons for every unlocked level.
The level's incident file types itself out, with the objective and a field note.

The level is simulated: shark, entities, exposure, strength, the hunter fleet and the win and fail checks. Once the goal is met, a 10-second countdown runs on screen; the fail checks still apply during it.
The simulation is stopped behind the pause menu.
The level is sealed: statistics, the clear bonus, the score and the cover-story memo; after the last level, the ending, which also ends the run.
The level is lost: strength ran out, the photos reached the dive boat, or the current went cold. The run ends, with a name entry when its score makes the table.
The high-score table kept on this device.
A run ended from the pause or clear screen with a qualifying score: the name entry for the high-score table.

transitions.trigger: Begin, Continue or a file button

transitions.action: startLevel() builds the level and the shark; a new run starts at score 0

transitions.trigger: P, Esc, the PAUSE button, or the page being hidden

transitions.action: startLevel() rebuilds the level and puts the score back to its value when the file began

the level's check() succeeds and the shark then survives a 10-second countdown
